meta.title: Event reasoning — AvailableCopiesCountView
meta.description:
## Event → field reasoning — AvailableCopiesCountView

- **CopyAdded** → +1 (new copy starts available)
- **CopyReserved / CopyCheckedOut / CopySentForRepair / CopyReportedLost** → -1 (copy leaves the available pool)
- **CopyReturned / CopyReservationReleased / CopyReturnedFromRepair** → +1 (copy re-enters the available pool)

Single field, irreducible wide fan-in (8 events) — 'how many copies are available right now' is by construction a function of the copy's entire lifecycle. This is the documented exception to the >3-events heuristic, not a bundling problem: there is no other, narrower field riding along on this node.
